purpose: Screen raw/less-derived Sentinel-1 RTC features across the six independently measured Tyrone 3X plots before any replacement depth model is fitted.
geometry_rule: Apply a fixed 10 m inward buffer to each WGS84 plot after projection to EPSG:32612. Do not alter geometry after seeing feature values.
monthly_composite: Pixelwise median of all successful selected acquisitions in each calendar month.
screening_statistic: For each usable month and feature, classify each three-plot surface group as strictly increasing with measured depth order, strictly decreasing, or nonmonotonic using the plot median feature value.
candidate_signal_gate: A feature passes only if both surface groups independently pass the fixed monotonicity and seasonal-support rules and both groups have the same dominant direction.
same_depth_surface_check: Report TP1-vs-TP5, TP2-vs-TP6 and TP3-vs-TP7 feature differences descriptively; no pass threshold is fitted from these differences.
forbidden: changing thresholds after results are seen
training or fitting a replacement depth model

result_interpretation.pass: feature is a candidate depth-responsive signal worthy of further independent validation, not a depth formula
result_interpretation.fail: do not rescue by tuning this protocol; document the failure and move to the next predeclared physical feature family
